instruction: Generate the FastAPI boot infrastructure per design.md §1,§4.1,§4.7,§5.3,§5.4,§6. Files: src/app/__init__.py (empty), src/app/config.py (pydantic-settings BaseSettings with every env var in §6, exact validation: JWT_SECRET min_length 32 required no default, JWT_ALGORITHM default HS256, JWT_EXPIRES_SECONDS int 60-86400 default 3600, JWT_ISSUER default lecture-pulse, DATABASE_URL default sqlite:///./lecture_pulse.db must start sqlite, LOG_LEVEL enum default INFO, LOG_JSON bool default true, JOIN_CODE_LENGTH int 6-12 default 8, APP_ENV enum default dev; expose lru_cache get_settings()), src/app/db.py (SQLAlchemy engine from DATABASE_URL with connect_args check_same_thread False + StaticPool for :memory:, SessionLocal, declarative Base, event listener setting PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL synchronous=NORMAL foreign_keys=ON busy_timeout=5000, get_db dependency that commits on success/rolls back on exception/closes), src/app/logging_config.py (JSON formatter emitting ts,level,logger,request_id,msg,extra; configure_logging(settings)), src/app/security.py (encode_token(subject,role,settings)->jwt HS256 with sub,role,iss,iat,exp; decode_token(token,settings)->dict verifying exp+iss, raising on failure). Use PyJWT. Never log tokens.

inputs.reason: layout, config vars, db/PRAGMA, JWT design

acceptance: config.py validates JWT_SECRET min 32 and fails boot if missing
db.py sets WAL+foreign_keys pragmas and check_same_thread False
security.py round-trips a token via encode/decode and rejects bad iss/exp
get_db commits on success, rolls back on exception

instruction: Generate src/app/errors.py per design.md §4.5. Define AppError(code,message,http_status,details=None) base and subclasses AuthError(401), ForbiddenError(403), NotFoundError(404), ConflictError(409), ValidationAppError(422). Provide register_error_handlers(app) installing FastAPI exception handlers: AppError -> its status + JSON {error:{code,message,details}}; RequestValidationError -> 422 code=validation_error details=exc.errors(); generic Exception -> 500 code=internal_error generic message (log full traceback, never return it). Provide stable code constants (duplicate_response, duplicate_upvote, duplicate_rating, poll_closed, illegal_transition, not_enrolled, not_joined, forbidden, unauthorized, not_found, validation_error, session_not_active).

Generate all SQLAlchemy ORM models per design.md §2 (14 tables). Files: src/app/models/__init__.py (import every model so Base.metadata is complete), and one file per group: user.py (User), course.py (Course, Enrollment), session.py (LectureSession, Participant), poll.py (Poll, PollOption, PollResponse, PollResponseOption), question.py (Question, QuestionUpvote), pulse.py (Pulse, PulseResponse), audit.py (AuditLog). Use the exact columns, types, PK/FK, ondelete CASCADE, CHECK constraints and UNIQUE constraints from §2 including UNIQUE(poll_id,student_subject), UNIQUE(question_id,voter_subject), UNIQUE(pulse_id,student_subject), UNIQUE(course_id,student_subject), UNIQUE(session_id,student_subject), UNIQUE join_code, pulse rating CHECK 1..5, and the partial UNIQUE(session_id,status) WHERE status='active' on pulses (use Index with sqlite_where). Import Base from app.db. Timestamps timezone-aware UTC default now.
acceptance: all 14 tables present with correct columns
all NFR-3 UNIQUE constraints declared at DB layer
partial unique index for one active pulse per session

instruction: Generate Pydantic v2 request/response schemas per design.md §3. Files: schemas/__init__.py, common.py (ErrorBody{code,message,details}, ErrorEnvelope{error:ErrorBody}, generic ListResponse items wrapper), auth.py (TokenRequest{subject,role enum,display_name?,email?}, TokenResponse, MeResponse), course.py (CourseCreate, CourseOut, EnrollmentCreate{student_subject}, EnrollmentOut), session.py (SessionCreate{title}, SessionOut with optional join_code, SessionTransition{target enum active|ended}, JoinRequest{join_code}, JoinResponse, ParticipantOut), poll.py (PollOptionIn{text,is_correct?}, PollCreate{prompt,poll_type enum,is_quiz,options}, PollOptionOut WITHOUT is_correct, PollOut, ResponseCreate{option_ids:list}, ResponseOut, PollResultsOut{poll_id,poll_type,is_quiz,total_respondents,options:[{option_id,text,count}],correct_answer_rate:float|None}), question.py (QuestionCreate{text}, QuestionOut{...,upvotes}, UpvoteOut{question_id,upvotes}, ModerateRequest{status enum answered|dismissed}), pulse.py (PulseOut, PulseResponseCreate{rating int 1-5}, PulseResponseOut, PulseSentimentOut{pulse_id,total,average:float|None,distribution:dict}). Use ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) on Out models. Enforce enum + range validation. NEVER expose is_correct in any student-facing option schema.

Generate FastAPI DI dependencies per design.md §4.1-§4.4. Files: deps/__init__.py, deps/auth.py (Principal dataclass{subject,role}; get_current_principal(authorization header) extracting Bearer token, decoding via security.decode_token(get_settings()), returning Principal, raising AuthError on any failure; require_role(role) factory returning a dependency that calls get_current_principal then raises ForbiddenError if role mismatches), deps/access.py (require_course_owner(course_id), require_session_owner(session_id) resolving session->course.owner_subject, and helpers to resolve poll/question/pulse ownership up to the parent session owner; require_joined_participant(session_id) raising NotFoundError if session absent, ForbiddenError if caller has no participants row). These load via a db session (Depends(get_db)). Raise AppError subclasses only, never HTTPException.

Generate request-context middleware per design.md §4.7. Files: middleware/__init__.py, middleware/request_context.py (Starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware that assigns request_id = inbound X-Request-ID or uuid4, stores it in a contextvar exposed via get_request_id(), sets X-Request-ID response header, and emits one structured access log line per request with ts,level,request_id,method,path,status,duration_ms). Never log tokens or PII values.
acceptance: request_id set from header or uuid4
one access log per request, no token logged

instruction: Generate core services per design.md §2,§4.6,§5. Files: services/__init__.py, services/audit.py (write_audit(db,principal,action,target_type,target_id) inserting an audit_log row in the same txn, no flush/commit of its own), services/courses.py (create_course, list_courses_for_owner, get_course, add_enrollment catching IntegrityError->ConflictError('already enrolled'), remove_enrollment, list_enrollments; upsert user helper for /auth/token). Each state-changing fn calls write_audit. Services raise AppError subclasses only.
acceptance: each state change writes audit in same txn

instruction: Generate services/sessions.py per design.md §3.2-§3.3,§4.6. Functions: create_session(db,principal,course_id,title) generating a URL-safe join_code of settings.JOIN_CODE_LENGTH; list_sessions(course_id); get_session; transition_session(session_id,target) allowing only scheduled->active and active->ended else ConflictError('illegal_transition') stamping activated_at/ended_at; join_session(principal,join_code) -> NotFoundError if code unknown, ForbiddenError('not_enrolled') if student not enrolled in parent course, ConflictError('session_not_active') if session not active, idempotent re-join returns existing participant; list_participants(session_id). All state changes write audit.
acceptance: join_code is random URL-safe of configured length

instruction: Generate services/polls.py per design.md §2.6-§2.9,§3.4,§5.2. Functions: create_poll(session_id,data) validating >=2 options, quiz(is_quiz true) requires exactly one is_correct + poll_type single, plain poll requires zero is_correct; reject on session ended; open_poll (closed->open, requires session active else ConflictError), close_poll (open->closed); submit_response(poll_id,principal,option_ids) requiring poll open (else ConflictError poll_closed), option count valid for poll_type (single/quiz exactly 1, multiple >=1), all option_ids belong to poll (else ValidationAppError), insert poll_responses anchor + poll_response_options children in one txn, catching IntegrityError->ConflictError('duplicate_response'). All state changes write audit. Never return is_correct.
acceptance: quiz requires exactly one correct option; poll requires none; >=2 options
response to closed poll -> ConflictError poll_closed
duplicate response -> ConflictError duplicate_response via IntegrityError

instruction: Generate services/questions.py and services/pulse.py per design.md §2.10-§2.13,§3.5-§3.6,§5.2. questions.py: post_question(session_id,principal,text) requires session active (else ConflictError session_not_active); upvote_question(question_id,principal) insert catching IntegrityError->ConflictError('duplicate_upvote'), returns current upvote count; moderate_question(question_id,status) requires currently open else ConflictError. pulse.py: trigger_pulse(session_id,principal) requires session active, closes any prior active pulse for the session in the same txn then creates new active pulse; submit_rating(pulse_id,principal,rating) requires pulse active (else ConflictError pulse_closed), insert catching IntegrityError->ConflictError('duplicate_rating'). All state changes write audit.
acceptance: triggering a pulse closes the prior active pulse in same txn

instruction: Generate services/aggregation.py per design.md §5.1. All aggregates are single SQL GROUP BY statements (no python row loops). poll_results(db,poll_id): per-option counts via LEFT JOIN poll_options<-poll_response_options keeping zero-count options ordered by position; total_respondents = count of poll_responses; if is_quiz compute correct_answer_rate = distinct responses selecting a correct option / total (0.0 if none), round 3dp else None. Return the PollResultsOut shape. question_ranking(db,session_id): questions LEFT JOIN upvotes GROUP BY question ORDER BY upvotes DESC, created_at ASC, include upvote count. pulse_sentiment(db,pulse_id): GROUP BY rating, fill 1..5 with zeros, total=count, average=AVG or None when total 0.
acceptance: zero-count options retained via LEFT JOIN
correct_answer_rate = correct/total, None when not a quiz, 0.0 when no respondents
ranking ordered by upvotes desc then created_at asc

instruction: Generate routers/__init__.py, routers/auth.py, routers/courses.py per design.md §3.1-§3.2. auth.py: POST /auth/token (no auth) upserts user + mints token via security.encode_token returning TokenResponse; GET /auth/me (any) returns MeResponse from principal. courses.py: POST /courses (instructor), GET /courses (instructor, own), GET /courses/{id} (owner), POST /courses/{id}/enrollments (owner), DELETE /courses/{id}/enrollments/{student_subject} (owner, 204), GET /courses/{id}/enrollments (owner), POST /courses/{id}/sessions (owner), GET /courses/{id}/sessions (owner). Routers only parse/validate, resolve deps (require_role/require_course_owner/get_db), call services, serialize. No SQL in routers. Use exact status codes from §3.
acceptance: POST /auth/token returns bearer token + upserts user

instruction: Generate routers/sessions.py per design.md §3.3. Routes: GET /sessions/{id} (owner OR joined participant; omit join_code for students), POST /sessions/{id}/transition (owner) body SessionTransition, POST /sessions/join (student) body JoinRequest, GET /sessions/{id}/participants (owner). Resolve deps, call services.sessions, serialize, exact status codes (200/403/404/409/422).
acceptance: join_code omitted for student session reads

instruction: Generate routers/polls.py, routers/questions.py, routers/pulse.py per design.md §3.4-§3.6. polls.py: POST /sessions/{id}/polls (owner), POST /polls/{id}/open (owner), POST /polls/{id}/close (owner), POST /polls/{id}/responses (joined student), GET /polls/{id}/results (owner). questions.py: POST /sessions/{id}/questions (joined student), POST /questions/{id}/upvotes (joined student OR owning instructor), GET /sessions/{id}/questions (owner, ranked), POST /questions/{id}/moderate (owner). pulse.py: POST /sessions/{id}/pulses (owner), POST /pulses/{id}/responses (joined student), GET /pulses/{id}/sentiment (owner). Routers resolve deps + call services + serialize with the aggregation service for results/ranking/sentiment. Never expose is_correct. Exact status codes.
acceptance: results route owner-only and returns correct_answer_rate only for quizzes
upvote allows joined student or owning instructor
no is_correct in any response body

instruction: Generate src/app/main.py per design.md §1,§4. create_app() factory: read settings via get_settings(), configure_logging, create FastAPI app, add RequestContextMiddleware, include all routers (auth, courses, sessions, polls, questions, pulse), register error handlers via errors.register_error_handlers(app), and on startup ensure Base.metadata.create_all(engine) so the schema exists. Expose module-level app = create_app(). Import models package so all tables register on Base.metadata before create_all.
acceptance: create_app mounts all routers + middleware + error handlers

instruction: Generate Python project files at repo src root. Files: src/requirements.txt (fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy>=2, pydantic>=2, pydantic-settings, PyJWT, pytest, pytest-cov, httpx — pin nothing tighter than major). src/pyproject.toml with [tool.pytest.ini_options] setting testpaths=[tests], addopts='--cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=80', and pythonpath=['.'] so `app` and `tests` import cleanly when pytest runs from src/. Include [tool.coverage.run] source=['app'] omit tests. Add src/README placeholder note not needed (README generated separately).

Generate two env files from design.md §6. src/.env.example: every variable key with NO value (KEY= form) and a short comment for each; JWT_SECRET commented as required min 32 chars. src/.env.test: schema-valid fixture VALUES for every key — JWT_SECRET='test-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456' (>=32 chars), JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256, JWT_EXPIRES_SECONDS=3600, JWT_ISSUER=lecture-pulse, DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///:memory:, LOG_LEVEL=WARNING, LOG_JSON=false, JOIN_CODE_LENGTH=8, APP_ENV=test. The two files MUST list the same keys.
acceptance: .env.example lists all keys with no values
.env.test supplies schema-valid values for the same keys

instruction: Generate src/tests/conftest.py per design.md §7.2. Set required env (JWT_SECRET etc.) before importing app if not already set. Fixtures: engine (sqlite:///:memory: StaticPool check_same_thread False, Base.metadata.create_all, drop between tests), db session, client = TestClient(create_app()) with get_db overridden to the test session and get_settings cache cleared. Token factories instructor_token(subject) and student_token(subject) minting real HS256 tokens via app.security.encode_token with the test settings, plus auth_header helpers. Provide a helper to create a course+active session+enrolled+joined student to reduce boilerplate.
acceptance: client fixture overrides get_db to test session
real HS256 token factories for both roles

instruction: Generate src/tests/test_auth.py, test_courses.py, test_sessions.py using the conftest fixtures. Cover AC-2 (student token on instructor route ->403; no/invalid token ->401), course create/list/get, roster add/remove (duplicate enroll ->409), session create/list, AC-7 lifecycle guards (scheduled->ended ->409, ended->active ->409), AC-6 join enforcement (non-enrolled ->403, join scheduled/ended ->409, respond without join ->403), AC-8 validation (malformed body ->422 with {error:{code,message,details}}). Use TestClient + token factories.

Generate src/tests/test_polls.py, test_questions.py, test_pulse.py using conftest fixtures. Cover AC-1 full poll lifecycle (create+open poll, >=2 students respond, GET results counts correct, close, further response ->409), AC-3 double submit (second poll response ->409 duplicate_response; second upvote ->409 duplicate_upvote; second pulse rating ->409 duplicate_rating), response to closed poll ->409 poll_closed, is_correct never present in any student-facing body, question post requires active session, moderate owner-only, pulse trigger closes prior active pulse.
acceptance: poll lifecycle end-to-end asserts correct counts then 409 after close
asserts is_correct absent from student payloads

instruction: Generate src/tests/test_aggregation.py and test_concurrency.py. aggregation: AC-4 quiz correct_answer_rate equals correct/total for a mixed response set; AC-5 pulse sentiment distribution 1..5 + mean matches submitted ratings; poll counts with a zero-count option retained. concurrency (AC-9/NFR-1): use a temp-file SQLite DB (WAL) and threads to (a) submit the SAME (poll,student) many times asserting exactly one succeeds and the rest raise ConflictError/return 409, and (b) submit from N distinct students to the same poll asserting all counted and total correct. Keep thread count modest (e.g. 20) for CI speed while proving the invariant.
acceptance: concurrency test asserts exactly one duplicate wins
